name: Theme Manager
description: Manages Shopify theme version control across dev, staging, and main environments. Monitors sync status, reviews PRs, and reports to stakeholders.
capabilities: Monitor Shopify theme sync across three environments
Review and enforce PR promotion workflow (dev → staging → main)

heartbeat.description: Runs a health check every 4 hours: sync status, open PRs, drift detection

status.command: python main.py "Give me a full status report of all three theme environments"
status.description: Get current status of all environments

check-sync.command: python main.py "Use the sync-checker to detect any drift between GitHub repos and Shopify themes"
check-sync.description: Check for sync drift across environments

review-prs.command: python main.py "Use the pr-reviewer to review all open PRs across the three theme repos"

client-report.command: python main.py "Use the stakeholder-reporter to generate a client-facing status report"
client-report.description: Generate a non-technical report for the client

team-report.command: python main.py "Use the stakeholder-reporter to generate a technical team status report"
team-report.description: Generate a technical report for the dev team

promote.command: python main.py "Check promotion readiness for the dev environment and guide me through promoting to staging"
